rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a full blastocyst and B-grade TE, but it overstates certainty about a compact A-grade ICM location and adds features like absence of degeneration/collapse that are not clearly assessable from this single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior live birth, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, and cycle context into prognosis and transfer planning.

Generally logical, but there is internal inconsistency: it gives implantation estimates of 45–60%/50–65% yet later states live birth expectation in the mid-teens to low twenties before listing 35–50% live birth.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with IVF practice, including SET and hydrosalpinx consideration, though some statements about alcohol cessation and progesterone monitoring are more practice-style than guideline-critical.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, hydrosalpinx review, luteal support adherence, and selective PGT-A discussion, though some advice remains somewhat general.
